questions.solution_html:
• . Distinguish between the four outcomes represented in a confusion matrix.
  • TP:Model correctly predicts positive class, TN: Model correctly predicts negative class, FP:
  • Model predicted positive which is actually negative, FN: Model predicted negative which is
  • actually positive. [Award 0.75 marks for each correct definition ]

questions.question: Explain the difference between hard margin and soft margin SVM. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the difference between hard margin and soft margin SVM.
  • Hard margin: No misclassification allowed but data must be perfectly separable. 1 mark
  • Soft margin: Allows some misclassification for better generalization, Soft margin works better
  • with noisy datasets. 2 marks
